prompt: How does one Compose file make an AI application easier to inspect? Evidence run 20260923-145159.

fresh.answer: In the Aspire AppHost orchestration, the Compose file makes an AI application easier to inspect by declaring services, containers, dependencies, startup order, and endpoints in one application model [3]. This consolidated information allows for better visibility and understanding of the application'ran configuration, contributing to smoother inspection and maintenance processes [1][2].
